test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 17 Nov, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All pens are laptops.

All laptops are computers.

**Conclusions:**

I. All pens are computers.

II. All laptops are pens.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Statements:

All pens are laptops.

All laptops are computers.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a63a18e585295e135bb0acf372dcf07e2743e02c0b4cf278b0e3f519fb7bf03c.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All pens are computers. - **True **(because All pens are laptops and All laptops are computers. So, All pens are computers too)

II. All laptops are pens. - **False **(because All pens are laptops. So, All laptops are pens it can be possible but not definite)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**
